scope: Sealed holdout predictions (54) for 2022-07..2026-06 scored against life-events.json set=holdout, date <= 2026-06-30. Event list: magnitude >= 3 (50 events).
rules: hit = domain + direction + window overlap (+-3 months allowed at window edges). Pratyantar-level calls that match only through the edge allowance are scored partial, because rule-12 claims days-to-weeks precision. false-alarm = a specific claimed development that did not happen. Null calls ('nothing happens') that held are hits but flagged nullCall.
contamination: The predictor disclosed that it recognised the person (SEAL.txt, METHOD.md). It states it did not knowingly use post-2022-06 knowledge, but several hits are more specific than the rules justify (p-16, p-25, p-32, p-37, p-42, p-43, p-52). Treat all numbers as an upper bound on the chart method.
